All names, declaration entries and mutual metadata resolved from the unchanged parsed fixture; no fabricated missing map entry

failure_attribution.qualification: Reserved candidate constants are intentionally undeclared. These cells test early guard enforcement, not a semantic accept/reject pair with only a prefix change. Removing the guard may still reject later, which MUST NOT satisfy the expected assertion. Unchanged PUnit is a complete baseline control, not proof of full validity of the changed type.

permanent_dag_recipe: Use a fresh owned ExportFile from test_get_export_file(ProjFromProp/config.json).

Intern CowStr::Borrowed _nested and Probe into export.dag.strings; build Name::Str nodes from anonymous with hash64!(STR_HASH, pre, suffix); intern and wrap each index in Ptr::from(DagMarker::ExportFile, idx).

Intern an empty Arc<[LevelPtr]> into dag.uparams; construct Expr::Const with hash64!(CONST_HASH,name,levels); intern and use ExportFile-marked ExprPtr. Mirror current parser insertion; never overwrite an interned node or fake a hash.
Change DeclarInfo.ty in the declaration map only. Scope mutable borrows before immutable validation/check_declar. Never carry a TcCtx-marked pointer across with_ctx calls.
limits: Mutual-peer guard at inductive.rs:47 is audited in source but is not isolated by these single-inductive enforcement cells. A future complete mutual fixture needs a separate useful-design gate.
Traversal cells exercise supported crate-internal raw expression APIs; ill-typed App/Local constructions are not presented as public importer inputs.
No literals are required; NatLit and StringLit have no name-bearing children and are source-only leaf exclusions, avoiding duplicate native-extension setup.
No compilation, test or mutation sensitivity result has been observed. No serialized export modification or new export bytes are generated.
later_execution_gate: Select and commit a distinct bounded execution item; do not launch in this source assessment
Freeze exact current source, test patch, fixture hashes, expected cells, dependency/tooling identities and runner/time accounting before each launch
Use 90 active minutes, 8 source/setup requests, at most 3 compiling builds <=600 seconds each and 4 test processes <=120 seconds each; compiling tests consume both counters
Test-only change; no production fix or mutation/new serialized export/proof/external write; failures repair within same item and cumulative budget
Run focused tests and current full Nanoda suite, then required Lab current/historical full-payload closure suite
Fresh source/duplicate/capacity review and exact target-specific owner approval before any upstream submission
